title: OBD-II Monitor Testing Not Complete
shortDescription: The vehicle's readiness monitors have not all completed since the last code clear or battery disconnect.
fullDescription: DTC P1000: The vehicle's readiness monitors have not all completed since the last code clear or battery disconnect. This is part of the OBD-II monitor / emissions diagnostic family. Most codes in this range relate to readiness monitors or specific sensor self-tests defined by the manufacturer.
safetyImpact: These codes generally indicate sensor or monitor issues and rarely cause immediate safety problems, but may mask other faults.

causes.cause: Recent battery disconnect or code clear (drive cycle not completed)

symptoms: Check Engine Light may or may not be on
Vehicle may fail emissions readiness check
Drivability complaints possible
Reduced fuel economy

fixSteps.title: Read Codes and Freeze Frame
fixSteps.instruction: Use an OBD-II scanner to retrieve all stored codes and freeze-frame data. Note readiness monitor status.

fixSteps.title: Perform Drive Cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Drive the vehicle through a complete OBD-II drive cycle so all monitors can run. Re-check readiness status afterward.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Related Sensor Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Visually inspect wiring and connectors for the affected sensor. Repair any chafing or corrosion found.

fixSteps.title: Test or Replace Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Test the sensor against the manufacturer's specification. Replace if out of range and re-verify code clears.

faq.q: Will this code prevent me from passing emissions?
faq.a: Yes — most P10xx codes either set the MIL or leave a monitor incomplete, which causes an emissions inspection failure.

faq.q: How long is a complete drive cycle?
faq.a: Typically 15-30 minutes of varied driving including idle, steady cruise, and deceleration, after the engine reaches full operating temperature.

faq.q: Can I clear the code and pass inspection?
faq.a: No. Clearing codes resets monitors to 'not ready', which itself fails most inspections.
